rationale: Whole-feature integration includes the existing supported verification_v1 subset and its original tests/documentation. No frozen mapping/report is altered and the repository framework imports no experimental verifier. Existing unchecked analysis consumers, unsupported historical formats and Increment24 closure remain separate unfinished obligations. Ordinary Git integration creates no scientific grant or new binding guarantee.
duplicate_disposition: Preserve existing UUID, payload, parent and state. Evidence only; no approval, grant, B-number, dispatch, closure or protected-main publication.
